days.title: Arrival in Delhi · Transfer to Nainital · Trip to Naina Devi Temple and Naini Lake
days.body: Start your journey by boarding your transfer from Majnu Ka Tilla to Nainital. Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. Then, get ready to explore Naina Devi Temple, a revered Hindu site where it is believed the eye of Sati fell. Next, visit Naini Lake, surrounded by lush greenery and breathtaking hill views. You can also enjoy a boat ride here (at an extra cost). Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nainital Sightseeing Tour
days.body: Today, get ready to explore the beautiful sights of Nainital. Start your tour by boarding your transfer to the Eco Cave Garden, which features interconnected caves and rocky formations, Snow View Point, and Tiffin Top. Explore Bhimtal Lake, named after Bhima from the Mahabharata. Discover Naukuchiatal, a nine-cornered lake, and Sattal, a group of seven interconnected lakes perfect for bird-watching and relaxation. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure to Delhi
days.body: In the morning, check out of your hotel and board your transfer to Majnu Ka Tilla, Delhi. Upon arrival, continue your journey back home. This marks the end of your trip.
